name: Docusign
description: Docusign eSignature is an electronic-signature and agreement workflow platform for sending, signing, tracking, and managing documents. Its self-serve plans include reusable templates, audit trails, mobile-responsive signing, reminders, and integrations; higher tiers add team collaboration, web forms, payments, bulk send, and more advanced workflow controls.
best_for: Individuals, legal teams, sales teams, and other businesses that need a mature e-signature workflow with audit trails, templates, recipient tracking, integrations, and scalable agreement-management options.
features: Send documents for electronic signature and track envelope status through completion
Real-time audit trail, reminders, reusable templates, and mobile-responsive signing
Standard plan collaboration features including shared templates, commenting, branding, and delegated signing
Business Pro features including web forms, payment collection, advanced form fields, and bulk send
1,000+ partner integrations plus APIs and connections to cloud storage and productivity platforms
Enhanced and IAM plans for larger organizations needing custom envelope limits, centralized administration, SSO, and broader agreement workflows

tiers.name: Personal
tiers.notes: Annual commitment billed monthly ($132 annual commitment). Includes 5 envelopes per month, agreement storage, AI-assisted summary, reusable templates, and 1,000+ integrations.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Annual commitment billed monthly ($360 per user annually). Includes up to 100 envelopes per user per year plus shared templates, real-time commenting, branding, delegated signing, and team controls.

tiers.name: Business Pro
tiers.notes: Annual commitment billed monthly ($540 per user annually). Adds web forms, payment collection, advanced fields, data verification, bulk send, and other advanced agreement features.

tiers.name: Enhanced plans
tiers.notes: Contact sales for customized eSignature or IAM packaging, envelope limits, centralized administration, SSO, and advanced enterprise features.

pros: Publishes clear self-serve pricing for Personal, Standard, and Business Pro in the U.S. storefront
The same eSignature platform covers solo use through team collaboration, with enhanced plans available for larger organizations
Official feature tables document audit trails, templates, mobile signing, integrations, and APIs across plans
cons: The headline U.S. prices shown are tied to an annual commitment even though payments are billed monthly
Standard and Business Pro annual plans include up to 100 envelopes per user per year, so high-volume senders may incur overage charges or need a customized plan
SSO, organization management, custom envelope limits, and several advanced security/workflow capabilities require an Enhanced or higher plan

faq.question: How much does Docusign eSignature cost?
faq.answer: On Docusign's U.S. annual-commitment pricing view, Personal is $11/month, Standard is $30/user/month, and Business Pro is $45/user/month. Enhanced plans use custom sales pricing.

faq.question: Does Docusign have a free plan?
faq.answer: Docusign's current eSignature pricing page does not list a permanent free tier. Docusign does offer a free trial for eSignature.

alternatives.name: PandaDoc
alternatives.description: A document workflow platform for proposals, quotes, contracts, e-signatures, and higher-tier CPQ and payment collection.
alternatives.best_for: Sales and operations teams that want proposal creation and sales-document workflows alongside e-signature.
strengths: CPQ and payment workflows on higher tiers
